Hi,

Is the action to *play* Clandestine Contract a different action from
using the "may enter combat with the vampire with this card" ability
(for NRA purposes)?

That is, could you play CC on a vamp, beat him a bit, untap, and then
take another action to attack him again with the CC ability?
